scope: 110-case actual App VM regression using real Vue with controlled doubles; Android and Harmony JS bridges, not native-device acceptance
current_shared_room_replacement: Shared-room create/handshake and action/rollback/reconnect are exercised separately; these are synthetic tests, not device or service acceptance.
